chapter: Spirits of Rhythm and the road in the 1930s
title: Acting like a father to the young Spirits
summary: He was unmarried then and tried to be nice to the 19- and 20-year-old members.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did you have a family at this time, like around -- at that time, like early '34, '35, in there?
You weren't married at that point.
You were out on your own.
Yeah. I've just had the family since I've been out here.
But it sounds like -- that you were in a way acting like --
Sounds kind of like you were acting like a daddy or an uncle, though.
Yeah. Well, I was trying to be nice to them, you know.
Well, they were all pretty young, right?
Yeah. Trying to be nice to them was the only way I knew how to do, because that's the way I was brought up.
But me and Doug had a fight.
